name: Display P3 Color Gamut
description: Display P3 is a wide-gamut color space developed by Apple/DCI for digital cinema and modern displays. It covers ~45% of visible colors vs sRGB's ~36%. Supported on all modern Apple devices, many Android devices, and newer monitors.

geometry.shape: Parallelepiped (skewed cube) — larger than sRGB in XYZ space

notable_gains: Much wider red gamut — vivid oranges and reds that sRGB can't show
Wider green gamut — saturated greens, lime, emerald
vs_srgb.backward_compatible: sRGB is a strict subset of Display P3. All sRGB colors are valid P3 colors.

art_notes: Display P3 is the practical wide-gamut target for web generative art in 2025. Safari, Chrome, and Firefox all support it. If you're making vivid, saturated art, you're leaving color on the table by staying in sRGB. Go P3. The reds especially.
